description: Game systems wiring — engagement loops, economy, achievements, progression tracking. All logic-only, no visual/rendering changes.

userStories.title: Wire quiz completions to daily goals
userStories.description: Create middleware that listens for quiz session completion events and increments dailyGoals.reviewsCompleted counter. Bridge the gap between quiz completion logic and the daily goals slice so the Daily Dashboard reflects actual progress.
acceptanceCriteria: src/store/middleware/quizDailyGoalsMiddleware.js listens for quiz completion actions
Increments dailyGoals reviewsCompleted counter on each quiz finish
Only counts completed sessions (not abandoned mid-quiz)
Threshold reward: dispatch dailyGoals/claimReward when daily target met
Handles edge case: multiple quick quizzes in same minute don't double-count
Tests: 12+ tests covering increment, threshold, edge cases
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Check existing quiz completion actions in vocabulary slice and dailyGoalsSlice.js reducers. Follow middleware patterns from vocabRateMiddleware.

userStories.title: Progressive tashkeel fading engine
userStories.description: Build pure functions that determine diacritic visibility level per word based on FSRS stability. Words the player knows well gradually lose their diacritics, forcing real reading. If the player gets a word wrong, tashkeel reverts to full for 3 days.
acceptanceCriteria: getTashkeelLevel(wordId, fsrsCard) returns FULL | PARTIAL | NONE
FULL when stability < 7 days, PARTIAL when 7-30 days, NONE when > 30 days
applyTashkeelFading(arabicText, level) strips diacritics according to level
PARTIAL mode keeps harakat only on first letter of each word
Recovery: if word answered wrong, revert to FULL for 3 days (check lastFailDate)
Tests: 14+ tests covering all levels, fading logic, recovery, edge cases
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Check if src/utils/tashkeelFading.js already exists. Use stripDiacritics from arabicUtils.js. Pure functions only — no middleware needed.

userStories.title: Quest marker visibility rule engine
userStories.description: Build a pure function rule engine that determines what quest marker an NPC should show based on quest state, player progress, and preconditions. Returns marker type for each NPC so the world layer can render appropriately.
acceptanceCriteria: getNpcQuestMarker(npcId, questState, playerState) returns 'available' | 'active' | 'completable' | null
Checks preconditions: CEFR level gates, friendship thresholds, previous quest chain completion
getAvailableQuests(playerState, allQuests) returns filtered list of quests player can start
Quest chain support: quest B requires quest A completed
Selector: selectNpcMarkers(state) returns map of npcId → marker type
Tests: 14+ tests covering all marker states, preconditions, chains
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read questSlice.js and npcSlice.js to understand existing quest/NPC data models. Pure functions + selector, no middleware.

userStories.title: Economy price decay and supply respawn
userStories.description: Implement the economy service that decays item prices toward baseline and respawns shop supplies daily. Prevents economy softlock where items become too expensive or permanently out of stock.
acceptanceCriteria: updateEconomyState(currentState, daysSinceLastUpdate) returns updated prices and supply
Prices decay 2% per day toward baseline (prevents runaway inflation)
Supply respawns 30% per day toward max (prevents permanent stockout)
High-demand items (purchased 20+ times/week) get +30% price surge
economyDecayMiddleware triggers daily on dailyGoals/claim or session start
Tests: 12+ tests covering decay math, supply respawn, surge pricing, multi-day catch-up
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read economySlice.js — check dynamicPricing state and recordPurchase reducer. Follow existing middleware daily trigger patterns.

userStories.title: Achievement trigger event system
userStories.description: Wire achievement unlock conditions across all game systems. The achievementMiddleware currently only covers battle/quizzes — extend it to vocabulary milestones, CEFR tiers, skill tree progress, economy actions, and faction reputation.
acceptanceCriteria: evaluateAchievementConditions(achievementDef, playerState) returns true/false
Vocabulary triggers: word milestones at 10, 50, 100, 500, 1000, 2500
CEFR triggers: reaching each level (A1→A2, A2→B1, etc.) per skill
Skill tree triggers: first node unlocked, full tree unlocked
Economy triggers: haggle count milestones, total dinars spent milestones
Faction triggers: join faction, max reputation
Tests: 16+ tests covering each trigger category
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read achievementSlice.js (44 achievements) and achievementMiddleware.js. Extend existing middleware, don't replace it. Check FEATURES.md for designed achievements.

userStories.title: CEFR progress report generation
userStories.description: Build a pure function that aggregates FSRS vocabulary cards and placement test results into a structured CEFR progress report showing overall level, per-skill breakdown, progress since placement, and estimated hours to next level.
acceptanceCriteria: generateCefrReport(vocabularyCards, placementResult) returns structured report object
Report includes: overall CEFR level, per-skill breakdown (reading, writing, grammar, listening, speaking)
progressSincePlacement shows delta, lagging skills, and advanced skills
estimatedHoursToNextLevel extrapolates from current FSRS learning pace
selectCefrReport(state) memoized selector for Redux store
cefrProgressMiddleware recalculates after vocab card updates
Tests: 14+ tests covering report accuracy, edge cases, estimation logic
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read cefrProgressSlice.js and placementSlice.js. Check how FSRS cards are tagged with CEFR levels. Pure aggregation logic.

userStories.title: NPC relationship decay and gift preferences
userStories.description: Implement relationship decay so NPC friendships decrease with inactivity, and a gift preference system where each NPC has favorite/disliked gift categories affecting friendship gain multipliers.
acceptanceCriteria: decayRelationships(relationships, daysElapsed) reduces each NPC friendship by 1-2 points per inactive day
Minimum friendship floor of 0 (never goes negative)
getNpcGiftPreference(npcId, giftCategoryId) returns multiplier: disliked=0.5x, neutral=1.0x, liked=2.0x, favorite=5.0x
Each NPC has 2 favorite and 2 disliked gift categories defined in data
relationshipDecayMiddleware triggers daily
Tests: 12+ tests covering decay math, gift multipliers, floor, multi-day catch-up
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read companionSlice.js and npcSlice.js for relationship data model. Gift categories should come from existing crafting/inventory data.

userStories.title: Adaptive quiz question pool selector
userStories.description: Build a service that selects quiz questions optimized for the player's current difficulty level and FSRS retrievability. Targets 70-85% success rate by filtering words in the right retrievability window and ordering quiz types by appropriateness.
acceptanceCriteria: selectAdaptiveQuizPool(playerDifficulty, vocabCards, targetCount) returns ordered word list
Filters words to 0.5-0.85 retrievability range (sweet spot for learning)
Orders quiz types by difficulty appropriateness using difficultyEngine rankings
Session trajectory: starts medium, adjusts after every 3 questions based on performance
adjustSessionDifficulty(currentDifficulty, last3Results) returns updated difficulty
Tests: 14+ tests covering pool selection, retrievability filtering, session adjustment
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read difficultyEngine.js for existing difficulty ranking. Check how FSRS retrievability is calculated in the codebase. Pure functions, no server endpoint needed.

userStories.title: Root magic spell discovery engine
userStories.description: Build the rule engine that determines when spells become available for discovery. A spell unlocks when the player knows the Arabic root, has learned the required morphological patterns, meets the elemental affinity threshold, and meets the level requirement.
acceptanceCriteria: canDiscoverSpell(spellId, playerState) returns true if all conditions met
Checks: root knowledge (vocabulary), morphological pattern mastery (grammar), elemental affinity score, player level
getDiscoverableSpells(playerState, allSpells) returns list of newly available spells
Spell prerequisite graph: Form I spells unlock Form II, Form II unlocks Form III, etc.
selectDiscoverableSpells(state) memoized selector
Tests: 14+ tests covering individual conditions, prerequisite chains, edge cases
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read rootMagicSlice.js and spellData.js. Check grammar progression data for morphological patterns. Pure discovery logic only.

userStories.title: Zone entry micro-review middleware
userStories.description: Create middleware that triggers a micro-review opportunity when a player enters a zone. Checks if the zone has any FSRS-due vocabulary cards and selects up to 3 for quick review, with a 1-hour cooldown per zone to avoid nagging.
acceptanceCriteria: zoneEntryReviewMiddleware listens for world/enterZone actions
getZoneDueCards(zoneId, vocabCards, now) returns up to 3 most urgent due cards for that zone
Urgency score: (now - nextReview) / interval — highest urgency first
1-hour cooldown per zone: skip if zone was reviewed within last hour
Only selects vocabulary tagged with the zone's vocabulary set
Dispatches microReview/suggest action with selected cards
Tests: 14+ tests covering card selection, urgency sorting, cooldown, zone filtering
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Check how zones are defined and how vocabulary is tagged to zones. Follow middleware patterns from progressSnapshotMiddleware for session-level guards.
